operations.name: signIn
operations.label: Sign in to GitHub
operations.description: Asks GitHub for a code, shows it on the sign-in page, and adds the Account once the person allows it.

operations.name: cancelSignIn
operations.label: Cancel GitHub sign-in
operations.description: Stops waiting for the GitHub sign-in in the browser.

capabilities.reason: Reads the signed-in user and is the host of the Account this Plugin provides.
Asks for the device sign-in code and exchanges it for a token.
